source: USGS SIM 3464, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars (1:75,000). Feature service layer 8.

Aeb.name: Eolian bedform unit
Aeb.interp: Amazonian-aged bedforms and transverse aeolian ridges (TARs) composed of unconsolidated sediment oriented orthogonal to the dominant east-west wind direction (Day and Dorn, 2019).

su.name: Smooth unit, undivided
su.interp: Sediments contributed from mass wasting, a widespread deposit of volcanic, or eolian origin, or residual accumulation of sand, pebbles, and cobbles due to deflation of the landscape.
